# 04. Domain model, ports và adapters

## 04.1. Domain model cốt lõi

Core SDK cần có các value object rõ ràng. Không truyền primitive soup như `x, y, z, rx, ry, rz, speed` xuyên nhiều tầng.

| Domain object | Nội dung | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|
| `JointState` | `name`, `position_rad`, `velocity_rad_s`, `effort_optional`, timestamp | Effort có thể không có. |
| `JointTarget` | target joint position rad, tolerance, motion profile | Production command chính. |
| `CartesianPose` | position m, orientation quaternion, frame id | Không dùng Euler làm representation nội bộ chính. |
| `TransformStamped` | parent frame, child frame, $T \in SE(3)$, timestamp | Dùng cho frame tree. |
| `MotionProfile` | max velocity/accel hint, duration, interpolation mode | Với MyArm speed có thể chỉ là hint. |
| `IkRequest` | target pose, seed joint, constraints | Không gửi hardware. |
| `IkResult` | success/failure, q solution, residual, reason | Có reason rõ. |
| `Trajectory` | sequence of joint/pose samples, time_from_start | Dùng cho controller/benchmark. |
| `HardwareStatus` | connected, enabled, fault, firmware status, device statuses | Tổng hợp từ hardware adapters. |
| `ObservationFrame` | image, tag detection, joint feedback, status, sim data | Thuộc HardwarePort. |
| `CommandResult` | accepted, rejected, timeout, completed, fault reason | Dùng cho state machine/benchmark. |

## 04.2. Application boundary API

Application dùng API framework-level:

```python
robot.get_joint_state()
robot.get_hardware_status()
robot.move_to_joint_target(target)
robot.move_to_pose(pose)
robot.plan_to_pose(pose)
robot.register_custom_frame(frame_spec)
robot.get_transform(parent_frame, child_frame)
robot.get_observation(query)
robot.start_runtime_profile("benchmark_t1")
robot.stop()
```

Application không gọi trực tiếp raw firmware API trong production path. Nếu cần benchmark legacy path, phải đi qua `BenchmarkLegacyFirmwareAdapter` với config rõ ràng.

## 04.3. Port danh sách chính

| Port | Trách nhiệm | Ví dụ adapter |
|---|---|---|
| `FrameGraphPort` | Quản lý frame, transform, custom workspace/environment. | Internal frame graph, ROS TF adapter, replay transform adapter. |
| `KinematicsPort` | FK, Jacobian, IK, singularity/manipulability. | Pinocchio, PoE, FirmwareCoordLegacy, MoveIt2 kinematics client, mock. |
| `PlannerPort` | Sinh path/trajectory, check feasibility. | Internal joint trajectory, MoveIt2 planner, simple Cartesian sampler, replay planner, mock. |
| `ControllerPort` | Execute trajectory/target theo policy. | Position joint controller, legacy firmware coord controller, ros2_control bridge, fake controller. |
| `HardwarePort` | Actuator, sensor, camera, encoder, firmware status, simulated/replay devices. | MyArmMControl real, MyArmM real, Logitech camera, fake hardware, replay, Gazebo, MuJoCo. |
| `RuntimePort` | Chạy application runtime và communication. | Python direct, ROS 2 node, WebSocket server, gRPC server, ZMQ bridge. |
| `DebugPort` | Logging, tracing, visualization, report. | No-op, JSONL logger, rosbag2, CSV/Parquet, online plot, offline plot. |
| `BenchmarkPort` | Sinh test case, chạy trial, supervise process, score metric. | T1/T2/T3/T4 runners, dry-run runner, replay runner. |

## 04.4. Adapter 0..N và capability-based design

`HardwarePort` không giả định lúc nào cũng có đủ robot, camera, sensor. Một runtime có thể gắn 0..N adapter.

Ví dụ runtime headless chỉ có robot:

```yaml
hardware_port:
  adapters:
    - id: robot_arm_01_m750
      role: manipulator
      adapter: myarm_mcontrol_real
```

Ví dụ benchmark external observer:

```yaml
hardware_port:
  adapters:
    - id: robot_arm_01_m750
      role: manipulator
      adapter: myarm_mcontrol_real
    - id: camera_01_wrist
      role: wrist_rgb_camera
      adapter: logitech_c922_v4l2
    - id: camera_02_shoulder
      role: shoulder_rgb_camera
      adapter: logitech_c922_v4l2
    - id: tag_detector_01
      role: external_pose_observer
      adapter: apriltag_opencv
```

Ví dụ CI không có hardware:

```yaml
hardware_port:
  adapters:
    - id: robot_arm_01_fake
      role: manipulator
      adapter: fake_joint_robot
    - id: camera_01_replay
      role: wrist_rgb_camera
      adapter: replay_image_folder
```

## 04.5. Plugin registry

Plugin registry không nhất thiết phải phức tạp ở v0.0.3. Có thể bắt đầu bằng YAML + factory mapping.

```yaml
kinematics_plugins:
  pinocchio_default:
    class: myarm_m750_sdk.kinematics.PinocchioKinematicsAdapter
    config: config/core_sdk/kinematics.pinocchio.yaml
  poe_crosscheck:
    class: myarm_m750_sdk.kinematics.PoeKinematicsAdapter
    config: config/core_sdk/kinematics.poe.yaml

hardware_plugins:
  myarm_mcontrol_real:
    class: myarm_m750_sdk.hardware.MyArmMControlAdapter
    config: config/adapters/myarm_mcontrol_real.yaml
  fake_joint_robot:
    class: myarm_m750_sdk.hardware.FakeJointRobotAdapter
    config: config/adapters/fake_hardware.yaml
```

## 04.6. Error handling ở port boundary

Port không nên throw exception tùy tiện ra application nếu có thể trả về result object có reason rõ.

Ví dụ `IkResult.reason`:

```text
SUCCESS
OUT_OF_REACH
JOINT_LIMIT
SINGULARITY_RISK
MAX_ITERATION
NUMERICAL_FAILURE
INVALID_FRAME
ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE
```

Ví dụ `CommandResult.reason`:

```text
ACCEPTED
REJECTED_BUSY
REJECTED_UNSAFE
REJECTED_PROFILE
MOTION_TIMEOUT
NO_MOTION_DETECTED
HARDWARE_FAULT
ADAPTER_EXCEPTION
MANUAL_RESET_REQUIRED
```

## 04.7. Raw firmware short path như một adapter riêng

Raw firmware path không bị xóa hoàn toàn vì cần benchmark so sánh.

```text
Application benchmark runner
  -> BenchmarkPort
  -> LegacyFirmwareCoordAdapter
  -> pymycobot write_coords/get_coords
```

Quy tắc:

1. Tên adapter phải có `legacy` hoặc `raw`.
2. Config mặc định tắt.
3. Chỉ benchmark/diagnostic profile được bật.
4. Mọi command phải có timeout và process watchdog.
5. Không dùng adapter này trong production profile.
